During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] attempted to perform a [[Sith Emperor's ritual|dark side ritual]] that would allow him to consume the life force of [[The galaxy/Legends|the entire galaxy]], and he sent his agents out across the galaxy in order to take advantage of the chaos and perform the sacrifice necessary to start the ritual. However, the Emperor was '''opposed''' by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]], who had broken free of the Emperor's mental control and joined forces with the former [[Emperor's Wrath]] Lord [[Scourge (Sith)|Scourge]] after the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] revealed the Emperor's plans. With aid from the rest of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]], and the Hero's own crew, the Knight foiled the Emperor's agents on [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], [[Voss]], and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], freeing the other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] under the Emperor's control in the process. After learning of the Emperor's location on the Imperial capital of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], the Hero [[Dromund Kaas operation|infiltrated]] the [[Dark Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] while the Republic fleet engaged the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] above the Dromund Kaas, and in a final battle the Knight managed to strike down the Sith ruler and seemingly end the threat he posed to the galaxy.
